Bounded by, extending as far as; सपुदपर्यंता पृथ्वी ‘the oceanbounded earth’. --तः 1 Circuit. circumference. --2 Skirt, edge, border. extremity, boundary; उटजपर्यंतचारिणी Ś. 4: पर्यतवनं R. 13. 38; Rs. 3. 3. --3 Side, flank; Ratn. 2. 3: R. 18. 43. --4 End, conclusion, termination; Pt. 1. 125. --Comp. --देशः, --भूः, --भूमिः f. an adjoining district or region. --पर्वतः an adjoining hill.

a partic. mode of sitting on the ground (a squatting position assumed by ascetics and Buddhists in meditation), Buddh. (cf. below)

पर्य्-अङ्किका f., a bed, couch, sofa, litter, palanquin, Kād.

a: पर्यश्रु — a. Bathed in or suffused with tears, shedding tears, tearful: पर्यश्रुणी मंगलभंगभीरुर्न लोचने मीलयितुं विषेहे Ki. 3. 36; पर्यश्रुरस्वजत मूर्धनि चं पजघ्रौ R. 13. 70.

a: पर्यग्निः — Ved. 1 Circumambient fire. --2 A torch carried round the sacrificial animal; or the ceremony of carrying round such fire.

पर्य्-अग्नि—कृत (पर्˚), mfn. encircled with fire, Br.
पर्य्-अग्नि—क्रियमाण mfn. being encircled with fire

पर्यगु mfn. (?) in पारमहंस्यप्˚, BhP. iv, 21, 40.
पर्य्-अह्न m., APrāt. Comm.
पर्य्-अक् ind. (orig. n. of an unusual पर्य्-अञ्च् ; cf. प्रत्य्-अञ्च् &c.) round about, in every direction, BhP.
a: पर्यक् — ind. Round about, in every direction.

m: पर्य्-√ अन् P. पर्य्-अनिति, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 20, Vārtt. 1, Pat.
पर्यन्ती-√ कृ to finish
पर्यन्ती—कृत mfn. finished, Divyāv.
पर्यन्तीय mfn. being at the end, ĀpŚr.
पर्य्-अन्त m. circuit, circumference, edge, limit, border
side, flank, extremity, end, TBr.; MBh.; Kāv. &c. (ifc. ‘bounded by’, ‘extending as far as’ [f(आ). ]; or ibc. ‘adjoining, neighbouring’)
पर्य्-अन्त mf(आ)n. coming to an end with, being a match for, Lalit.
extending in all directions, Hariv. (v.l. पर्य्-अस्त).
पर्य्-अन्त—भू f. ground contiguous to the skirts of a river or mountain, W.

k.v: पर्यन्तभूः परिसरः सेतुरालौ स्त्रियां पुमान्. वामलूरश्च नाकुश्च वल्मीकं पुन्नपुंसकम्.।

m: पर्य्-अन्त—देश m. a neighbouring or adjacent district, Hariv.
पर्य्-अन्तम् (अम्), ind. entirely, altogether, Śukas.
(ifc.) to the end of, as far as, Kap.
पर्यन्तात् पर्यन्तम्, from one end to the other, Var.
पर्य्-अन्त—पर्वत m. an adjoining hill, L.
पर्य्-अन्त—स्थ (Kathās.) mfn. limitative, confining, neighbouring.
पर्य्-अन्त—स्थित (W.) mfn. limitative, confining, neighbouring.
पर्य्-अन्त—संस्थित (Ṛt.) mfn. limitative, confining, neighbouring.
पर्य्-अन्ते (ए), ind. at the end, Kathās.
पर्यन्तिका f. loss of all good qualities, depravity, L.
पर्य्-अनु-बन्ध m. (√ बन्ध्) binding round, L.
पर्य्-अनु-˚योग m. asking, inquiring, questioning, ĀpŚr., Sch.
an inquiry with the object of refuting a statement, L.
censure, reproach, Yājñ., Sch.
a: पर्यनुयोगः — 1 An inquiry with the object of contradicting or refuting a statement (दूषणार्थं जिज्ञासा Halāy.); एतेनास्यापि पर्यनुयोगस्यानवकाशः Dāy. B. --2 Asking, inquiring. --3 Censure, reproach.

m: पर्य्-अनु-˚योज्य mfn. to be blamed or censured (˚ज्योपेक्षण n. omitting to blame what ought to be blamed), Nyāyas.; Sarvad.
पर्य्-अनु-˚योज्योपेक्षण n., omitting to blame what ought to be blamed
पर्य्-अनु-˚योक्तव्य mfn. to be questioned, to be urged to answer a question, Śaṃk.
पर्य्-अनु-√ युज् (ind.p. -युज्य, Naiṣ.), to ply with questions.
पर्य्-अनु-˚युक्त mfn. asked, questioned, Car.
पर्य्-अन्व्-√ 3. इष् P. -इच्छति, to seek for, search after, MBh.
पर्यन्य w.r. for पर्जन्य.
a: पर्यन्य — = पर्जन्य q. v.

m: पर्य्-अर्षण See under पर्य्-ऋष्.
पर्य्-अर्षण n. clasping round, supporting, making firm, ŚBr.
पर्य्-√ 1. अस् P. पर्य्-अस्ति, (3. du. परि-ष्टः; 2. pl. परि-ष्ठ; pf. पर्य्-आस), to be in the way of (acc.), RV.; to pass or spend time, ib.

पर्य्-√ 2. अस् P. Ā. पर्य्-अस्यति, ˚ते, to throw or cast or place round, AV.; AitBr.; to spread round, diffuse, Kir.; to entrap, ensnare (Ā. aor. 3. du. पर्य्-आसिषाताम्, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 52, Sch.); to turn round, wallow (ind.p. पर्य्-अस्य), Amar.; to throw down, overturn, upset (aor. पर्य्-आस्थत्), ŚBr.; Mn.; Kathās. : Pass. पर्य्-अस्यते (aor. पर्य्-आस्थत, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 52, Sch.), to tall down, drop: Caus. पर्य्-आसयति, to cause to roll down or shed (as tears), Ragh.
a: पर्यस् — {c4c} P. 1 To throw or cast round, spread round, diffuse. --2 To spread over, surround; ताम्रौष्ठपर्य स्तरुचः स्मितस्य Ku. 1. 44. --3 To turn round; पर्यस्तविलोचनेन Ku. 3. 68 --4 To shed, throw down (as tears); R. 10. 75; Ms. 11. 184. --5 To overturn, upset. --6 To throw about; R. 18. 13; 5. 49. --7 To entrap, ensnare. --8 To enclose.

m: पर्य्-˚असन n. throwing or tossing about, Car.
casting, sending, W.
putting off or away, ib.
a: पर्यसनं — 1 Casting, throwing about --2 Sending forth, throwing. --3 Sending away. --4 Putting off or away.

m: पर्य्-˚अस्˚ताक्ष mfn. having the eyes cast or directed round, rolling the eyes. (AV.)
पर्य्-˚अस्त mfn. thrown or cast about, spread, diffused, MBh.; Kum.; Amar.
surrounded, encompassed, ensnared, R.; Bhartṛ.
strung, filed on (comp.), Daś.
overturned, upset, inverted, changed, Bhartṛ.
struck, killed, L.
dismissed, laid aside, ib.
a: पर्यस्त — p. p. 1 Thrown round, scattered over or about; पर्यस्तो धनंजयस्योपरि शिलीमुखासारः Ve. 4: Śi. 10. 91. --2 Surrounded, encompassed. --3 Upset, overturned. --4 Dismissed, laid aside. --5 Struck, hurt; killed. --6 Bound.

m: पर्य्-अस्तमयम् ind. about sunset, ŚāṅkhŚr.
पर्य्-˚अस्त—वत् mfn. containing the notion expressed by the word पर्य्-अस्त, AitBr.
पर्य्-˚अस्त—विलोचन mfn. having the eyes cast or directed round, rolling the eyes. (Kum.)
पर्य्-˚अस्ति f. sitting upon the heels or hams, L.
a: पर्यस्तिः — f., पर्यस्तिका Sitting upon the hams; see पर्यंक {3}

m: पर्य्-˚अस्तिका f. id., Suśr.
a bed, W.
पर्य्-˚अस्ति˚काकृति mfn. one who has sprained both his shoulders, L.
पर्य्-अवाप् (-अव-√ आप्) P. -अवाप्नोति, to study, Divyāv.

पर्य्-अव-˚शेष m. end, termination, MW.
a: पर्यवशेषः — End, termination.

पर्य्-अवच्छिद् (-अव-√ छिद्) P. -च्छिनत्ति (-च्छिनदानि), to cut off on both sides or all round, AitBr.
पर्य्-अव-˚दान n. complete destruction or disappearance, Lalit.
पर्य्-अव-˚दापयितृ m. (fr. Caus.) a distributor, Divyāv.
पर्य्-अव-दात mfn. (√ दै) perfectly clean or pure, Kād.
very accomplished, Divyāv.
well acquainted or conversant with (loc.), Car. (-त्व n.)
well known, very familiar, ib.

पर्य्-अव-नद्ध mfn. (√ नह्) overgrown, Divyāv.

पर्य्-अव-˚पाद m. transformation, ib.
पर्य्-अव-˚पा˚द्य mfn. effecting transformation, ib.
पर्य्-अव-पन्न mfn. (√ पद्) broken down, destroyed, annihilated, frustrated, Pat.

a: पर्यवरोधः — Obstruction, hinderance.

पर्य्-अव-˚सायि-त्व n.

पर्य्-अव-˚स्था f. opposition, contradiction, L.
a: पर्यवस्था — {c1c} P. 1 To set out. --2 To be or exist everywhere. --3 To rely upon. --Caus. To compose or collect oneself; न पर्यवस्थापयत्यात्मानं V. 1.

merry, content, comfortable, of good cheer, ib.

finished, concluded, ended, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
amounting to (loc.), Śaṃk.
resolved, settled, definitive, Sāh.

a: पर्यवसो — {c4c} P. 1 To complete, finish. --2 To determine, resolve. --3 To result in, be reduced to, end in; एष एव समुच्चयः सद्योगंऽसद्योगे सदसद्योगे च पर्यवस्यतीति न पृथक् लक्ष्यते K. P. 10. --4 To perish, be lost, decline.
